items.exampleEn: My little brother likes to share his toys with me.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟喜歡和我分享他的玩具。

items.exampleEn: We visit our grandparents every month.
items.exampleZh: 我們每個月去探望祖父母。

items.exampleEn: Tom is my partner in this game.
items.exampleZh: Tom 是我這場遊戲的搭檔。

items.sentenceEn: My sister and her husband visit us often.
items.sentenceZh: 我的姊妹和她先生常來看我們。

items.audioEn: Our guests are here! Can you get some cups for them?
items.audioZh: 我們的客人到了！你可以幫他們拿一些杯子嗎？

items.sentenceEn: This present is from my daughter.
items.sentenceZh: 這份禮物是我女兒送的。

items.sentenceEn: Tom is my partner at work.

items.stemEn: My ____ is a doctor. She works at a hospital.
items.stemZh: 我女兒是醫生，她在醫院工作。

items.stemEn: I want to ____ my aunt in Tainan this weekend.
items.stemZh: 這個週末我想去台南拜訪我阿姨。

items.passageEn: Every summer, my sister visits us with her husband and their daughter. They are our guests for two weeks. My sister always brings presents for my kids. We share many meals, and we play games together at night.
items.passageZh: 每年夏天，我的姊妹會和她先生還有女兒來我們家。他們會在我們家作客兩個星期。我的姊妹總是帶禮物給我的孩子。我們一起吃很多頓飯，晚上一起玩遊戲。

questions.questionZh: 作者的姊妹一家每年夏天在說話者家住多久？
作者的姊妹總是帶什麼來？

items.promptZh: 我可以和你分享這塊蛋糕嗎？
referenceEn: Can I share this cake with you?
May I share this piece of cake with you?
rubricZh: share 後面接分享的東西，再用 with 接人（例如 share this cake with you）
用表示請求的問句（例如 Can I…?、May I…?、Could I…?）
「這塊蛋糕」可寫 this cake、this piece of cake 等

items.promptZh: 很多人夏天去參觀那座寺廟。
referenceEn: Many people visit that temple in summer.
In summer, many people visit the temple.
rubricZh: visit 後面直接接地點，不加 to（例如 visit the temple）；寫 go to the temple 也正確
「那座寺廟」可寫，例如 that temple、the temple 等
